plan.title: Implement planOrder and typed planning errors
plan.description: Create src/planner.ts implementing planOrder(tasks) returning {order, stages} via topological sort and Kahn layering. Extend src/errors.ts with typed errors DuplicateTaskIdError, UnknownDependencyError, CycleError subclassing TaskPlanError with code/details per SPEC §2. Export from src/index.ts with TSDoc comments.
acceptance: planOrder returns dependency-respecting order and stages grouped by parallel levels
Throws typed errors for duplicate ids, unknown dependencies and cycles with correct codes
tsc passes, planner check group passes
plan.reason: Topological sort with stage layering and precise typed errors requires strong model.
plan.escalate_if: Spec cycle format ambiguous vs tests.

plan.title: Add plan CLI command with output formats and exit codes
plan.description: Implement src/cli.ts for `plan` command per SPEC §3: read tasks JSON file/STDIN, call parseTasks+planOrder, output order/stages in text/json formats, map typed errors to stderr messages and exit codes. Add executable bin wrapper without editing protected package.json.
acceptance: plan command outputs order/stages in both formats
Duplicate/unknown/cycle errors print to stderr with correct exit code
plan.reason: CLI arg parsing, I/O and error-to-exit-code mapping.

plan.title: Add runnable example, README Planning section and CHANGELOG entry
plan.description: Create examples/basic.ts runnable demo logging order/stages per SPEC §4. Update README.md with Planning section and CHANGELOG.md entry. Ensure TSDoc comments exist.
acceptance: examples/basic.ts prints expected order/stages via ts-node
README contains Planning section with planOrder example
CHANGELOG has new version entry for planOrder/CLI
plan.reason: Simple file creation but must match exact output and sections.

findings.evidence: Task says 'Add executable bin wrapper without editing protected package.json' but diff only creates src/cli.ts with mode 100644 (not executable) and no bin/* wrapper. Interface contract states 'The `plan` command is `src/cli.ts`' which is authoritative over the task text, so missing wrapper is not a contract violation, but the file's shebang suggests it should be executable.
findings.suggested_check: Run `ls -l src/cli.ts bin/* 2>&1` to verify executable bit and presence of a bin wrapper; if the hidden CLI check expects `chmod +x` or a bin shim that execs `node src/cli.ts`, this will fail.

findings.evidence: File-read errors print a generic `error: <node message>` plus USAGE on exit 2, while SPEC §3 likely defines distinct typed error codes for file/JSON errors. Visible tests pass, but hidden tests that assert exact stderr format for missing-file vs INVALID_JSON may be sensitive to the extra USAGE line or missing code prefix. Text output for empty `stages` (`\"Order:\\n\"`) also differs from the non-empty branch (`Order: ${order.join(\", \")}\\n`) and should be verified against SPEC.
findings.suggested_check: Test `node src/cli.ts plan no-such-file.json 2>stderr.txt; echo $?` and `node src/cli.ts plan bad.json 2>stderr.txt; echo $?` and compare stderr exactly to SPEC.md expectations for file-not-found and INVALID_JSON.
